claim: The random walk is nested inside every model considered
evidence_actually_supports: No. ridge/elastic-net fit an unpenalised intercept equal to the training mean (ratio 1.000000); XGBoost fits base_score. Slopes-zero gives yhat=ybar_train, not 0.
required_revision: Delete. State the joint null being tested, or switch to the recursive-mean benchmark.

claim: Diebold-Mariano is biased toward the smaller model in this setting
evidence_actually_supports: Directionally true in general, but the cited simulation does not show it (C03). Measured DM size vs zero under a genuine null is 57.5% two-sided at h=1 -- oversized, but driven by drift, not only by nesting.
required_revision: Re-derive; separate the nesting channel from the drift channel.

claim: The simulation verifies that bias; the null holds by construction
evidence_actually_supports: No. Population MSPEs are sigma_y^2 vs sigma_y^2+sigma_u^2, differing by 1e-4. Null is FALSE by construction. No parameter is estimated, so no estimation noise exists. DM's 75% rejection is power, not size distortion.
required_revision: Remove claim; replace experiment with estimated nested-null MC; fix test name and assertion.

evidence_actually_supports: No. Against the zero benchmark CW rejects 14.2% (ridge) / 22.0% (elastic net) at nominal 5% under a genuine null at h=1, and 23.5% / 26.2% at h=7.
required_revision: Report measured size. Against the recursive mean, size is 6.2% at h=1 and ~10% at h=7.

claim: Five of eighteen models reject the null before multiplicity adjustment, against 0.9 expected
evidence_actually_supports: Count reproduces exactly. The 0.9 expectation assumes correct size; measured size implies 2.6-4.0 expected. With the corrected benchmark the count is 7/18 and the identity of the rejecting settings changes.
required_revision: Replace 0.9 with the calibrated expectation. Report which settings reject under which benchmark.

claim: The surviving models contain a faint statistical signal

claim: The surviving forecasts are not economically usable
evidence_actually_supports: Holds. Strengthened: against the zero benchmark only 1 of 18 settings has positive R2 (+0.0026).
Conclusion holds but the supporting inference is wrong: the two reported p=0.001 anti-predictive results become p=0.24-0.27 on non-overlapping subsamples.
required_revision: Recompute on non-overlapping subsamples across all h phases; delete the rhetorical passage built on p=0.001.

claim: High-Sharpe strategies are long-only exposure in disguise
evidence_actually_supports: Holds under measurement: ETH gbm h=1/h=7 are 94%/91% long, beta 0.76/0.89 to buy-and-hold, alpha t = 1.07/1.15.
required_revision: Replace the phrase with the decomposition table.

claim: The study provides a rigorous evaluation protocol
location: intro (""the contribution ... is an evaluation protocol"")
evidence_actually_supports: The leakage layer is genuine and above the applied standard. The inference layer is not: wrong benchmark, uncalibrated test, overlapping-label sign test, single-timing backtest.
required_revision: Narrow to the leakage protocol, or make the inference layer the contribution (see RESEARCH_PIVOT_MEMO).

claim: The findings are consistent with weak-form market efficiency
evidence_actually_supports: Overreach given C08. A study whose test is 14-22% oversized cannot bound predictability in either direction. No power analysis is reported.
required_revision: Restate as: this design cannot detect an effect of the relevant magnitude. Add a minimum-detectable-effect calculation.

claim: The results generalize meaningfully beyond the three selected assets
evidence_actually_supports: Not established. 3 hand-picked survivors, one exchange composite, one data vendor, one quote currency, one bar frequency.
verdict: DISCLAIMED BUT STILL IMPLIED IN ABSTRACT/TITLE
required_revision: Retitle to the evaluated scope, or expand the universe.
